elaine: FYI - file a quick design: switch route tagging from freeform `tags` array to a single `route_group_id` integer for analytics aggregation. goal: cheaper rollups and stable grouping across customers. thoughts?

matt: I like the stable-id idea. main question: backfill strategy and read-compat. we can't break console dashboards.

rohan: agree. propose a compatibility layer: writes populate both old `tags` and new `route_group_id` for 2 weeks, reads prefer `route_group_id` if present, falls back to tags mapping. after backfill, drop tags in query surfaces.

priya: dashboard impact: we'll need to update saved queries + dashboard tiles to use `route_group_id`. we should add a human-readable mapping table `route_groups(id,name,owner)` for UI label resolution.

sam: sketch for backfill job: nightly job computes route_group_id for historical events using deterministic hash + mapping table, writes to analytics_enriched table. sample SQL:```
UPDATE analytics_enriched ae
SET route_group_id = rg.id
FROM route_groups rg
WHERE ae.route_tags @> ARRAY[rg.normalized_tag]::text[]
  AND ae.route_group_id IS NULL;
```

elaine: nice. SLA questions: how long to run backfill? estimate ~3 days at current throughput with rolling batching. we'll need to throttle to avoid overload. rohan can you own rate limits?

rohan: yep. I'll add a rate limiter in the backfill worker and a circuit breaker if insertion lag > 30m. also will expose a feature flag `use_route_group_id` to switch read path per service.

matt: deployment plan: 1) add route_groups table + adapter lib 2) start dual writes 3) backfill historical data 4) flip consoles + analytics queries behind flag 5) monitor and remove legacy tag-only code after 2 weeks.

priya: UX: during rollout console should show both name + id until we fully migrate. also need a migration checklist for PMs so dashboards don't silently break.

sam: QA: we should generate an anonymized sample dataset and run end-to-end compare on aggregates (count by group, p50 latency) before/after. I'll own the harness.

deploy-bot: deploy started: backfill-worker:v2 -> canary on analytics cluster (pods 1/3).

elaine: thanks. action items: matt owns schema + API changes; rohan owns backfill & rate-limits; priya owns dashboard migration; sam owns QA harness. I'll schedule a canary review Thu 11am.

matt: I'll open the PR with schema DDL and adapter functions today, tag reviewers.```
